split_reasoning: Directing production, pricing, sales, and distribution is the same broad coordination activity across business functions.

parts.text: Direct and coordinate business or departmental production, pricing, sales, or distribution activities.
parts.type_reasoning: The core work is live direction and coordination with subordinate managers rather than a single handed-over deliverable.

notes: Some direction may also be communicated in writing.

split_reasoning: Serving customers, stocking shelves, and physically counting inventory are different activities.

parts.text: Greet or assist customers on the sales floor.
parts.type_reasoning: The work takes place in a live interaction while the customer is present.
parts.unit_reasoning: One customer interaction is a natural unit of assistance.
parts.work_item: one customer assisted on the sales floor
parts.start: customer is greeted or asks for help
parts.end: assistance is provided and the interaction ends

parts.text: Stock shelves on the sales floor.
parts.type_reasoning: Moving and placing merchandise requires hands-on work away from a computer.

parts.text: Count merchandise as part of a physical inventory.
parts.type_reasoning: The central activity is physically checking and counting merchandise.

notes: Shares depend on the manager's involvement in floor operations; inventory counting may include recording counts.

split_reasoning: Developing a marketing strategy and implementing a campaign or promotion produce different outputs.

parts.text: Develop a product-marketing strategy.
parts.type_reasoning: The work produces a strategy that guides marketing decisions.
parts.unit_reasoning: A strategy for a product or product group is reviewed and used as a whole.
parts.start: need for a product-marketing strategy identified
parts.end: strategy documented and submitted or communicated for use

parts.text: Implement an advertising campaign or sales promotion under a product-marketing strategy.
parts.type_reasoning: Implementation results in a distinct campaign or promotion put into operation.
parts.unit_reasoning: A campaign or promotion is launched and tracked as a distinct initiative.
parts.work_item: one marketing campaign or sales promotion launched
parts.start: campaign or promotion approved for implementation
parts.end: campaign or promotion placed in operation

notes: Shares vary with whether the manager primarily develops strategy or oversees implementation.

split_reasoning: One activity: directing support departments through subordinate managers.

parts.text: Direct non-merchandising departments such as advertising or purchasing.
parts.type_reasoning: The value is in live supervision and direction of department heads.

split_reasoning: Joins recommending sites with overseeing remodeling; one is an analysis deliverable, the other is supervision.

parts.text: Recommend a location for a new facility.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a recommendation that executives decide on.
parts.unit_reasoning: One recommendation is made per facility decision.
parts.work_item: one site recommendation for a new facility

parts.text: Oversee remodeling or renovation of an existing facility with contractors.
parts.type_reasoning: Mostly directing and checking contractors in live conversation and site visits.

split_reasoning: A store layout and an individual merchandise display are different design deliverables.

parts.text: Plan a store layout.
parts.type_reasoning: The work produces a layout plan used to arrange a store.
parts.unit_reasoning: A layout plan for a store or defined area is reviewed and implemented as a whole.
parts.start: store or area identified for layout planning
parts.end: layout plan communicated for approval or implementation

parts.text: Design a merchandise display.
parts.type_reasoning: The work produces a design for a particular display.
parts.unit_reasoning: A display design is handed over for setup as one unit.

notes: Shares vary by store and season.

split_reasoning: Joins implementing programs (live directing and physical setup) and overseeing them; produce one program plan and ongoing oversight through reports.

parts.text: Set up an environmental or sustainability program plan or policy for recycling, conservation or waste.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a plan others implement and an official relies on.
parts.unit_reasoning: One program plan is written and approved.
parts.work_item: one environmental program plan or procedure

parts.text: Oversee running of the program with staff and review its results.
parts.type_reasoning: Oversight is done through live direction and review conversations.

split_reasoning: One activity: reviewing performance reports and finding improvements.

parts.text: Review financial statements and performance reports to measure goal achievement and identify cost reductions or improvements.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces conclusions and action items others use.
parts.unit_reasoning: Reviews happen per reporting period, each ending in findings.
parts.work_item: one periodic performance review of financial and activity reports
parts.end: findings and actions communicated to managers

split_reasoning: One activity: directing administrative support staff; value is in direction.

parts.text: Direct administrative activities that support production or service delivery.
parts.type_reasoning: Directing others is live interaction without a separate product.

split_reasoning: One activity: building schedules and assigning duties.

parts.text: Prepare staff work schedules and assign duties.
parts.type_reasoning: Each schedule is published and staff rely on it.
parts.unit_reasoning: A schedule is produced per period and handed to staff.
parts.work_item: one staff work schedule with assignments

split_reasoning: One activity: monitoring supplier performance against budget.

parts.text: Review a supplier's performance and costs against agreed terms and budget and act on shortfalls.
parts.type_reasoning: Each review ends in a finding or action regarding the supplier.
parts.unit_reasoning: Suppliers are reviewed one at a time per review cycle.
parts.start: review period ends or issue arises

split_reasoning: Joins budgeting with investments and efficiency; one deliverable is the budget, the other is oversight decisions.

parts.text: Prepare or approve an operating budget and funding plan.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a budget that others rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: A budget is made per period and approved as a whole.

parts.text: Direct financial staff on investments and efficiency measures.
parts.type_reasoning: Direction through live conversations with staff.

split_reasoning: One activity: setting policies and goals with others, mostly in meetings and followed by a written policy.

parts.text: Meet with officials and staff to set departmental goals and policies.
parts.type_reasoning: The value is in the live discussion.

parts.text: Write up and implement a departmental policy or procedure.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a written policy others follow.
parts.unit_reasoning: One policy or procedure document is issued at a time.
parts.start: decision to adopt or change policy

split_reasoning: Joins selection, training and evaluation, which are different activities.

parts.text: Select staff by reviewing applicants and making hiring decisions.
parts.type_reasoning: Each hire ends in a decision others rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each hire is filled one at a time from opening to offer.
parts.work_item: one hiring decision for an opening

parts.text: Train staff.
parts.type_reasoning: Training is live teaching.

parts.text: Evaluate a staff member's performance and write the review.
parts.type_reasoning: Each evaluation yields a written review placed in the file.
parts.unit_reasoning: One review per employee per cycle.

split_reasoning: One activity: planning and directing cross-department promotions, through coordination.

parts.text: Plan a sales promotion and coordinate it with other department managers.
parts.type_reasoning: Produces a promotion plan others execute.

parts.text: Direct the promotion while it is running with department managers.
parts.type_reasoning: Live coordination with colleagues.

split_reasoning: One activity: setting prices or credit terms from demand forecasts.

parts.text: Set prices or credit terms for goods or services based on demand forecasts.
parts.type_reasoning: Each decision is a price or terms list used by sales and customers.
parts.unit_reasoning: Prices are set per product line or period and issued as a whole.
parts.work_item: one price or credit-terms decision for a product or service
parts.end: prices or terms approved and communicated

split_reasoning: Planning goods movements and resolving movement problems are distinct outputs of ongoing management.

parts.text: Coordinate a plan for goods moving into or out of a production facility.
parts.type_reasoning: Ongoing management produces movement plans or schedules used by operating teams.
parts.unit_reasoning: A movement plan for a defined period or operating need is communicated as a unit.
parts.start: production, inventory, and shipment needs identified
parts.end: movement arrangements communicated to responsible teams

parts.text: Resolve an identified goods-movement problem affecting facility operations.
parts.type_reasoning: Monitoring movement produces discrete issues that require a decision or coordination response.
parts.unit_reasoning: One identified movement problem is investigated and its resolution communicated as a unit.
parts.start: delay, inefficiency, or other movement issue identified

notes: The balance between scheduled planning and exception handling depends on the operation.
